# Alex Shanjay — Video Editor & Graphic Designer (AX.Visuals)

> Alex Shanjay is a freelance video editor and graphic designer based in Jaffna, Sri Lanka, and the founder of AX.Visuals, a content studio that creates Reels, photos and brand videos for businesses. He works with clients across Sri Lanka (islandwide) and remotely worldwide.

Key facts:
- Name: Alex Shanjay
- Role: Video editor, graphic designer, founder of AX.Visuals
- Based in: Jaffna, Northern Province, Sri Lanka
- Serves: Businesses and creators islandwide in Sri Lanka; remote editing for international clients
- Specialities: cinematic edits, YouTube Shorts & Instagram Reels, motion graphics, colour grading, social-media design
- Typical clients: restaurants and cafés, hotels, salons and gyms, retail and fashion brands, product and e-commerce businesses, creators
- Contact: WhatsApp +94 76 401 5423 · Email shanjayalex09@gmail.com
- Website: https://www.alexshanjay.live

## Services

- [Video editing](https://www.alexshanjay.live/#services): Cinematic edits, YouTube videos, brand films, ad edits.
- [Shorts & Reels](https://www.alexshanjay.live/#services): Vertical short-form edits for Instagram, TikTok and YouTube Shorts, with hooks, captions, music and sound design.
- [Motion graphics](https://www.alexshanjay.live/#services): Animated titles, logo animations, text animation, lower thirds.
- [Colour grading](https://www.alexshanjay.live/#services): Cinematic colour correction and grading for film and social content.
- [Graphic & social design](https://www.alexshanjay.live/#services): Instagram posts, posters, thumbnails, brand graphics.

## AX.Visuals content packages (Sri Lankan Rupees)

- Starter Content — Rs. 25,000: 2-hour shoot, 2 Reels, 15 edited photos.
- Social Content (most popular) — Rs. 40,000: 3-hour shoot, 4 Reels, 25 edited photos.
- Premium Brand — Rs. 60,000: 5-hour shoot, 6 Reels, 40 edited photos.
- Full Content Day — Rs. 85,000: 8-hour shoot, 8–10 Reels, up to 60 edited photos.
- Monthly content plans from Rs. 55,000/month. Food & restaurant package Rs. 45,000. Product shoots from Rs. 20,000.
- Basic Reel editing from Rs. 4,000; premium Reel editing Rs. 6,000–8,000+.
- Travel charges may apply outside the local area. 50% advance confirms a booking.
